notes: One target: the container from docker-compose.yml. 127.0.0.1 is the honest value here - the container publishes on loopback, so this is not a placeholder standing in for a machine somewhere.
'server_id' is the identity every other file joins on. Even with one target it is worth reading as a decision: one machine, one id, never reused.

'cmd_access' is absent, so no OS metric is attempted. Reaching into the container to measure the laptop's CPU and reporting it under this instance's name would be a lie, and the toolkit refuses that shape (method 'local' with a remote host) rather than doing it quietly. Everything collected here comes from SQL.

db_instances.note: Throwaway container. 'database' is a real database name here - PostgreSQL connects to one, unlike SQL Server, where the connection database is always master and the metric SQL selects its own.
